international.title: EDF snaps up 1.3m more customers after Utilita takeover
international.summary: Britain’s fourth-largest energy supplier brings account base up to 6m after purchase of pay-as-you-go supplier EDF Energy will grow its share of the UK’s household energy market to more than 6m customer accounts after snapping up the pay-as-you-go supplier Utilita. Great Britain’s fourth-largest energy supplier expects to complete the takeover early next year, adding 1.3m accounts to its customer base and taking on Utilita’s 1,500 staff. The price of the deal was undisclosed. Continue reading...
